notes: The booklet builds two separate models: Naida's gondola (with the Naida figure) and the goblin's rock scene (with the goblin figure). Nothing joins the two models, so the graph has two groups on purpose; this L3 warning is not a real problem. The goblin stands on the scene's base and Naida sits on the gondola; both are contact edges.

Element IDs for the new types come from the inventory pages 31-32. Pieces are matched to IDs by shape and colour, so some may be wrong. 4211387 (grey brick 2x2), 6007894 (tall grey slope) and 4211365 (grey plate with pin) are printed on page 31, so I kept them despite the L1 warning. The torso (6178380) is printed on page 32. It is back on the catalogue type lego-friends-torso, with 6178380 in its props, so the count check can match it.
Naida's hair, head and legs use their own element IDs (6103116, 6102368, 6178906).

Exact stud positions are not visible in the small pictures. Stud-stack edges (which piece sits on which) are approximated. Their ports are left null because several pieces connect to the same stud area, so no single port applies.

Port choices: drumstick uses an anti-stud; the telescope sits on the clip mount by a bar (clip/bar); the clear gem is a ball in the telescope socket; the plant branch has pin-holes for the berries and branch plus a pin into the black pivot. The basket sits on a boat plate. Mini-doll joins have null ports.
The gondola has two brown hulls with two 1x8 plates between them. The bowl is held in Naida's hand and the sign tile in the goblin's hand.
The chest (b60) tilts on the red axle extender (b59), which is held by the black pivot (b58). The pivot turns on the grey pin plate (b48). These joints are modelled as revolute.
Step 15 shows two purple/lime flower pairs: one on the chest and one loose on the base, shown as a launched projectile. It is modelled as attached to the base.
